annotation.title_clean: Delaware Code Title 11, Chapter 5, Subchapter VII: Offenses Against Public Health, Order and Decency (§§ 1301-1474)
annotation.title_en: Delaware Code Title 11, Chapter 5, Subchapter VII: Offenses Against Public Health, Order and Decency (§§ 1301-1474)
annotation.summary_en: Delaware criminal code subchapter covering disorderly conduct, hate crimes, harassment, prostitution, obscenity, gambling and weapons offenses. Its only embodied-technology provision is § 1334, which bans operating unmanned aircraft systems over crowds, critical infrastructure and first-responder incidents, or for harassment or privacy invasion. It also preempts local drone rules.
key_provisions_or_claims: § 1334 prohibits flying drones over events of more than 1,500 people, critical infrastructure and active first-responder incidents.
Drone use to harass or invade privacy on private property is prohibited.
Exemptions cover law enforcement, owner permission, higher-education use and FAA-authorized commercial operators.
Penalties: unclassified misdemeanor for a first offense, class B for repeat offenses, class A if injury or damage results.
The State preempts county and municipal regulation of drone operation.
